# Requirements Management Software: Open Source Directory & Comparison Tool (2026)

> Verified comparison of 22 open-source and commercial requirements management software tools, filterable by engineering job, ReqIF support, Git workflow, and compliance standards (Verified: 2026-11-16).

## Summary
This repository provides a structured JSON dataset (`tools.json`), a zero-dependency Python CLI (`rm_advisor.py`), and an interactive GitHub Pages directory (`docs/index.html`) to help engineering, product, and compliance teams evaluate and select requirements management software.

## Top Tools by User Job
- **Git-Native & Docs-as-Code (Open Source)**: StrictDoc (Apache-2.0, ReqIF + Web UI), Doorstop (LGPL-3.0, YAML in Git), Sphinx-Needs (MIT, ReqIF + Sphinx), TReqs (MIT, Markdown + VS Code).
- **Regulated & Safety-Critical (ISO 26262, IEC 62304, DO-178C, FDA 21 CFR Part 11)**: Jama Connect, Siemens Polarion, PTC Codebeamer, IBM DOORS Next, Visure Requirements ALM, ReqView, MatrixALM, StrictDoc.
- **Agile & DevOps Integrations**: R4J (Jira), Modern Requirements4DevOps (Azure DevOps), GitLab Requirements Management, Plane (Open Source), Redmine (Open Source).
- **Systems Engineering & MBSE**: Valispace (Altium), Innoslate, Eclipse RMF (ProR, Open Source).

## Quick CLI Usage
- Filter open-source ReqIF tools: `python3 rm_advisor.py --license open-source --reqif`
- Compare up to 3 tools: `python3 rm_advisor.py --compare strictdoc reqview jama-connect`
- Guided recommendation: `python3 rm_advisor.py --recommend --workflow git-native --regulated --budget free`
- Validate dataset: `python3 rm_advisor.py --validate`
